info.name: Metkart Complete API Collection
info.description: Complete, fully-featured Postman collection for all Metkart backend endpoints: Health, User App (OTP Auth & Orders), Admin (Auth, Shopkeeper, Vendor Settings, Onboarding Approvals), Vendor (OTP Auth, Dashboard, Profile, Onboarding, Products), and Platform v1 APIs.

request.description: Public health check endpoint returning server status ok.
Registers a new user profile with full name, email, mobile, and address. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email. Account remains unverified until OTP verification.
Requests a login OTP for an existing verified user email.
Verifies the 6-digit email OTP. Automatically sets user to verified and returns JWT token and user info. Token is auto-saved as userToken and user._id as userId.
Generates and resends a new 6-digit verification OTP to the user email.
Creates a pending order for the authenticated user. Body userId must match the authenticated user. All productIds must be published products with available quantity.
Retrieves all orders placed by the user using userId in URL params. Does NOT require authentication.
Retrieves all orders containing products belonging to the specified vendorId. Does NOT require admin token.
Retrieves all platform orders with optional pagination (page, limit) and status filtering. Requires Admin Bearer token.
Creates an admin account. Save the returned token as adminToken.
Returns a Bearer token and saves it as adminToken.
